Mental health questions. Sensitive in nature.
RATE SUBJECTIVE IDEOMOTOR PRESSURE (42). Do things seem to go too slowly for you? Do you need less sleep than usual? Do you find yourself extremely active but not getting tired.

val_rows: Subjective equivalent of flight of ideas.  Images and ideas flash through the mind, each suggesting others, at a faster rate than usual. State persists for hours at a time
